# Wymber

> Wymber is a privacy-first, local-first tool for mapping and understanding difficult
> experiences (trauma mapping). Your map lives in a single encrypted vault on your own
> device; there are no accounts and no servers holding user data. Free and open-source
> (AGPL-3.0). Currently in alpha at https://web.wymber.app. Wymber is a self-help tool
> for personal reflection, not therapy, diagnosis, or a crisis service.

Citation is welcome; we decline AI training (see /robots.txt Content Signals).
